en.setting: Carrow Hall stands at the end of a lime avenue above the dale, its roof slates cracked and its west wing shuttered against the autumn damp. The estate has been declining for twelve years, and the study where the old man takes his brandy smells of cold ash and diminished fortunes.
en.crime: Archibald Carrow was found dead in his armchair with a half-drunk brandy beside him. The fire had burned to nothing, the room was cold, and the chloral hydrate in his glass had stopped his weakened heart.

suspects.name: Edmund Carrow
suspects.intro: Archibald's heir, who arrived a week early and whose coat lining shows fresh stitching near the inner pocket.

suspects.name: Flora Marsh
suspects.intro: The housekeeper who found the body at half past five, though the fire had been cold for hours.

suspects.name: Gideon Cobb
suspects.intro: A London solicitor whose handwriting matches annotations in the entailment deed.

suspects.name: Robert Carrow
suspects.intro: Next in line after Edmund, arrived from the village two days before with stable mud on his boots.

suspects.name: Dr Fenwick
suspects.intro: Last examined Archibald that afternoon, his medical bag containing a half-empty bottle of chloral hydrate.

suspects.name: Margaret Wells
suspects.intro: Archibald's former ward, whose letters to him over the past year were all returned unopened.

suspects.name: Silas Greer
suspects.intro: Estate caretaker found cleaning the study grate before the body was reported, holding every key on the property.

es.setting: Carrow Hall se erige al final de una avenida de tilos sobre el valle, sus pizarras de techo agrietadas y su ala oeste cerrada contra la humedad otonal. La finca ha estado en declive durante doce anos, y el estudio donde el anciano toma su brandy huele a cenizas frias y fortunas menguantes.
es.crime: Archibald Carrow fue encontrado muerto en su sillon con un brandy a medio beber a su lado. El fuego se habia consumido, la habitacion estaba fria, y el hidrato de cloral en su vaso habia detenido su corazon debilitado.

suspects.name: Edmund Carrow
suspects.intro: El heredero de Archibald, que llego una semana antes y cuyo forro del abrigo muestra costuras frescas cerca del bolsillo interior.

suspects.name: Flora Marsh
suspects.intro: El ama de llaves que encontro el cuerpo a las cinco y media, aunque el fuego llevaba horas frio.

suspects.name: Gideon Cobb
suspects.intro: Un abogado de Londres cuya escritura coincide con las anotaciones en la escritura de vinculacion.

suspects.name: Robert Carrow
suspects.intro: El siguiente en la linea despues de Edmund, llego del pueblo dos dias antes con barro de establo en sus botas.

suspects.name: Dr Fenwick
suspects.intro: Examino a Archibald por ultima vez esa tarde, su maletin medico conteniendo una botella medio vacia de hidrato de cloral.

suspects.name: Margaret Wells
suspects.intro: La antigua pupila de Archibald, cuyas cartas durante el ultimo ano fueron devueltas sin abrir.

suspects.name: Silas Greer
suspects.intro: Cuidador de la finca encontrado limpiando la rejilla del estudio antes de reportar el cuerpo, con todas las llaves de la propiedad.

fr.setting: Carrow Hall se dresse au bout d'une allee de tilleuls surplombant la vallee, ses ardoises de toit fissurees et son aile ouest condamnee contre l'humidite automnale. Le domaine decline depuis douze ans, et le bureau ou le vieil homme prend son brandy sent la cendre froide et les fortunes amoindries.
fr.crime: Archibald Carrow a ete retrouve mort dans son fauteuil avec un brandy a moitie bu a cote de lui. Le feu s'etait eteint, la piece etait froide, et l'hydrate de chloral dans son verre avait arrete son coeur affaibli.

suspects.name: Edmund Carrow
suspects.intro: L'heritier d'Archibald, arrive une semaine en avance et dont la doublure du manteau montre des coutures fraiches pres de la poche interieure.

suspects.name: Flora Marsh
suspects.intro: La gouvernante qui a trouve le corps a cinq heures et demie, bien que le feu soit froid depuis des heures.

suspects.name: Gideon Cobb
suspects.intro: Un avocat londonien dont l'ecriture correspond aux annotations de l'acte de substitution.

suspects.name: Robert Carrow
suspects.intro: Le suivant dans l'ordre de succession apres Edmund, arrive du village deux jours avant avec de la boue d'ecurie sur ses bottes.

suspects.name: Dr Fenwick
suspects.intro: A examine Archibald pour la derniere fois cet apres-midi, sa sacoche medicale contenant une bouteille a moitie vide d'hydrate de chloral.

suspects.name: Margaret Wells
suspects.intro: L'ancienne pupille d'Archibald, dont les lettres de l'annee ecoulee ont toutes ete retournees non ouvertes.

suspects.name: Silas Greer
suspects.intro: Le gardien du domaine trouve en train de nettoyer la grille du bureau avant que le corps ne soit signale, detenant toutes les cles de la propriete.

all_strong.en: Edmund Carrow arrived early because he could not afford to arrive late. The entailment expired on the first of January, and if his uncle lived past that date, the estate would go to auction and Edmund would inherit nothing. The chloral hydrate in the brandy, the camphor on the decanter stopper matching his coat, the burned letter in the grate, the altered ledger in his hand — the evidence drew a portrait of a desperate man who killed the season before it could turn. The hollow hall had claimed its last Carrow.
all_strong.es: Edmund Carrow llego temprano porque no podia permitirse llegar tarde. La vinculacion expiraba el primero de enero, y si su tio vivia mas alla de esa fecha, la finca iria a subasta y Edmund no heredaria nada. El hidrato de cloral en el brandy, el alcanfor en el tapon del decantador coincidiendo con su abrigo, la carta quemada en la rejilla, el libro de cuentas alterado en su mano — las pruebas trazaban el retrato de un hombre desesperado que mato a la estacion antes de que pudiera cambiar. El salon vacio habia reclamado a su ultimo Carrow.
all_strong.fr: Edmund Carrow est arrive en avance parce qu'il ne pouvait pas se permettre d'arriver en retard. La substitution expirait au premier janvier, et si son oncle vivait au-dela de cette date, le domaine irait aux encheres et Edmund n'heriterait de rien. L'hydrate de chloral dans le brandy, le camphre sur le bouchon du carafon correspondant a son manteau, la lettre brulee dans la grille, le registre altere de sa main — les preuves dressaient le portrait d'un homme desespere qui a tue la saison avant qu'elle ne puisse tourner. Le manoir creux avait reclame son dernier Carrow.

who_strong_rest_weak.en: Edmund's name hung in the cold air of Carrow Hall like pipe smoke that would not clear. The motive was plain — the entailment, the deadline, the debt — but the brandy could have been poured by any hand, and the chloral had a prescription with another man's name on it. The jury saw a man who needed his uncle dead by Christmas, and that was enough, though the method and the motive remained as murky as the autumn damp.
who_strong_rest_weak.es: El nombre de Edmund pendia en el aire frio de Carrow Hall como humo de pipa que no se disipaba. El motivo era claro — la vinculacion, el plazo, la deuda — pero el brandy pudo haber sido servido por cualquier mano, y el cloral tenia una receta con el nombre de otro hombre. El jurado vio a un hombre que necesitaba que su tio muriera antes de Navidad, y eso fue suficiente, aunque el metodo y el motivo permanecieron tan turbios como la humedad otonal.
who_strong_rest_weak.fr: Le nom d'Edmund planait dans l'air froid de Carrow Hall comme une fumee de pipe qui ne se dissipait pas. Le mobile etait evident — la substitution, la date limite, la dette — mais le brandy aurait pu etre verse par n'importe quelle main, et le chloral portait une ordonnance au nom d'un autre. Le jury a vu un homme qui avait besoin que son oncle meure avant Noel, et cela a suffi, bien que la methode et le mobile restent aussi troubles que l'humidite automnale.

wrong_accusation.en: The wrong Carrow was arrested, and Edmund watched from the east parlour as the constable led his cousin away. The entailment ran its course, the estate passed quietly into Edmund's hands, and Archibald's brandy decanter was put away in a cupboard that no one opened again. Margaret Wells's letters remained sealed in the desk drawer, the older will stayed hidden beneath the floorboards, and the hollow season turned to winter without justice.
wrong_accusation.es: El Carrow equivocado fue arrestado, y Edmund observo desde el salon este mientras el agente se llevaba a su primo. La vinculacion siguio su curso, la finca paso silenciosamente a manos de Edmund, y el decantador de brandy de Archibald fue guardado en un armario que nadie volvio a abrir. Las cartas de Margaret Wells permanecieron selladas en el cajon del escritorio, el viejo testamento oculto bajo las tablas del suelo, y la estacion hueca se convirtio en invierno sin justicia.
wrong_accusation.fr: Le mauvais Carrow a ete arrete, et Edmund a regarde depuis le salon est tandis que le constable emmenait son cousin. La substitution a suivi son cours, le domaine est passe discretement entre les mains d'Edmund, et le carafon de brandy d'Archibald a ete range dans un placard que personne n'a rouvert. Les lettres de Margaret Wells sont restees scellees dans le tiroir du bureau, l'ancien testament cache sous les lattes du plancher, et la saison creuse s'est muee en hiver sans justice.

cold_case.en: The file on Archibald Carrow's death was marked natural causes and placed beside the estate ledger in a drawer that smelled of camphor. The entailment expired, the auction never came, and the hall passed on through inheritance as the family intended. The study clock was never rewound, the brandy decanter never refilled, and the burned letter in the grate crumbled to nothing before anyone thought to read what remained. Carrow Hall kept its secrets the way old houses do — in silence, behind locked doors, through every hollow season that followed.
cold_case.es: El expediente sobre la muerte de Archibald Carrow fue marcado como causas naturales y colocado junto al libro de cuentas de la finca en un cajon que olia a alcanfor. La vinculacion expiro, la subasta nunca llego, y la mansion paso por herencia como la familia pretendia. El reloj del estudio nunca fue dado cuerda de nuevo, el decantador de brandy nunca rellenado, y la carta quemada en la rejilla se desmorono antes de que alguien pensara en leer lo que quedaba. Carrow Hall guardo sus secretos como lo hacen las casas antiguas — en silencio, detras de puertas cerradas, a traves de cada estacion hueca que siguio.
cold_case.fr: Le dossier sur la mort d'Archibald Carrow a ete marque causes naturelles et place a cote du registre du domaine dans un tiroir qui sentait le camphre. La substitution a expire, la vente aux encheres n'est jamais venue, et le manoir est passe par heritage comme la famille le souhaitait. L'horloge du bureau n'a jamais ete remontee, le carafon de brandy jamais rempli, et la lettre brulee dans la grille s'est effritee avant que quiconque ne pense a lire ce qui restait. Carrow Hall a garde ses secrets comme le font les vieilles maisons — en silence, derriere des portes verrouillees, a travers chaque saison creuse qui a suivi.

lucky_guess.en: Edmund's name was spoken because he was the heir and he was early and he needed the money. It was not evidence so much as arithmetic. The camphor on his coat might have come from anywhere, the chloral from any medical bag, the burned letter from any hand. But the shape of the thing pointed at Edmund, and in a village where everyone knows the family ledger, shape is enough. He was tried on suspicion dressed as certainty, and the hollow season passed its own quiet verdict.
lucky_guess.es: El nombre de Edmund fue pronunciado porque era el heredero, habia llegado temprano y necesitaba el dinero. No era tanto evidencia como aritmetica. El alcanfor en su abrigo podia provenir de cualquier parte, el cloral de cualquier maletin medico, la carta quemada de cualquier mano. Pero la forma del asunto senalaba a Edmund, y en un pueblo donde todos conocen el libro de cuentas familiar, la forma es suficiente. Fue juzgado por sospecha vestida de certeza, y la estacion hueca dicto su propio veredicto silencioso.
lucky_guess.fr: Le nom d'Edmund a ete prononce parce qu'il etait l'heritier, qu'il etait en avance et qu'il avait besoin d'argent. Ce n'etait pas tant des preuves que de l'arithmetique. Le camphre sur son manteau aurait pu venir de n'importe ou, le chloral de n'importe quelle sacoche medicale, la lettre brulee de n'importe quelle main. Mais la forme de l'affaire designait Edmund, et dans un village ou tout le monde connait le registre familial, la forme suffit. Il fut juge sur des soupcons deguises en certitude, et la saison creuse a rendu son propre verdict silencieux.

expressions.suspect:edmund_carrow: Edmund Carrow stood at the window with both hands behind his back. His collar was buttoned to the top despite the warm study.
expressions.event:sleeping_brandy: The brandy carried chloral hydrate dissolved past the point of taste. Combined with a weak heart, the dose was unsurvivable.
expressions.motive:inheritance_entailed: The entailment clause expires on the first of January. After that date, the estate passes to auction and Edmund receives nothing.
expressions.suspect:flora_marsh: Flora Marsh stood in the doorway with her apron strings already loose. She said she found him at half past five but the fire was cold.
expressions.suspect:gideon_cobb: Gideon Cobb arrived from London on the evening train with a leather case. His handwriting matched the annotations in the entailment deed.
expressions.suspect:robert_carrow: Robert Carrow rode in from the village two days before the death. His boots still carried stable mud when he entered the dining room.
expressions.suspect:dr_fenwick: Dr Fenwick last examined Archibald at four in the afternoon. His medical bag contained a half-empty bottle of chloral hydrate.
expressions.suspect:margaret_wells: Margaret Wells had been Archibald's ward until the age of twenty-one. Her letters to him over the past year were returned unopened.
expressions.suspect:silas_greer: Silas Greer was found cleaning the study grate before the body was reported. His key ring held every lock on the estate.
expressions.location:carrow_hall: Carrow Hall stands at the end of a lime avenue above the dale. The roof slates are cracked and the west wing is shuttered.
expressions.location:main_study: The study faces south and holds a desk, a chair, and a decanter on a side table. The curtains were drawn when the body was found.
expressions.location:servants_corridor: The servants' corridor runs behind the main rooms without a window. A door at each end locks from the inside.
expressions.location:dining_room: The dining room table was set for two on the evening in question. One chair had been pushed back and the napkin was unfolded.
expressions.location:library_wing: The library wing contains three thousand volumes and a locked cabinet. The cabinet key hangs on a nail behind the atlas shelf.
expressions.location:dispensary_room: The dispensary adjoins the kitchen passage and holds a glass-front cabinet. Two bottles stand apart from the others on the lower shelf.
expressions.location:stable_yard: The stable yard lies beyond the kitchen garden wall. A single horse was stabled there overnight, hired from the village inn.
expressions.location:east_parlour: The east parlour is the only room Edmund uses when visiting. A ledger of estate debts sits open on the writing table.
expressions.object:brandy_decanter: A crystal decanter sits on the study side table, three-quarters empty. A faint cloudiness is visible at the neck.
expressions.object:brandy_glass: A glass stands beside the armchair, half-drunk. The residue ring shows the level did not change after the last sip.
expressions.object:chloral_bottle: A small brown bottle sits in Dr Fenwick's medical bag. The wax seal has been broken and re-pressed.
expressions.object:entailment_deed: The entailment deed is dated 1889 and runs to fourteen pages. Clause seven specifies that succession expires on the first of January.
expressions.object:estate_ledger: The estate accounts show twelve years of declining income. The final column is written in a different hand from the rest.
expressions.object:camphor_tin: A tin of camphor sits in the left pocket of Edmund's coat. The same compound was found on the stopper of the decanter.
expressions.object:fireplace_ash: The study grate holds fragments of a burned letter. One legible corner reads before the new year.
expressions.object:returned_mail: A bundle of Margaret's letters sits in Archibald's desk drawer, still sealed. The stamps are cancelled but the envelopes are unopened.
expressions.object:stable_receipt: A receipt for one horse, hired to Robert Carrow, was signed at the village inn. The date is two days before the death.
expressions.object:prescription_pad: Dr Fenwick's prescription pad lies in his bag beside the chloral bottle. The top sheet has been torn away.
expressions.object:study_key: A brass key to the study was found on Silas Greer's ring. It sits alongside eleven other estate keys.
expressions.object:will_fragment: A torn corner of an older will was found between the study floorboards. The fragment names Margaret Wells as sole beneficiary.
expressions.object:clock_face: The study clock stopped at 11:47 in the evening. The winding key is missing from its hook.
expressions.emotion:controlled_grief: He received the news without sitting down. His hand moved to his watch chain and stayed.
expressions.emotion:frayed_composure: Her voice broke once on the word 'morning' and did not break again. She folded her hands in her lap.
expressions.emotion:cold_precision: Every answer was delivered in the same measured tone. He did not look away from the inspector once.
expressions.emotion:silent_watching: He stood at the garden wall and watched the constable enter. His pipe had gone out but he did not relight it.
expressions.emotion:measured_patience: She waited three full seconds before responding to each question. Her answers were complete and offered nothing extra.
expressions.emotion:bitter_silence: He said nothing when shown the stable receipt. His jaw tightened and he looked toward the window.
expressions.modifier:cloudiness_visible: A faint cloudiness sits at the neck of the brandy decanter. The liquid below the line is perfectly clear.
expressions.modifier:re_pressed_seal: The wax seal on the entailment deed shows a double impression. The original crest was softened and re-pressed.
expressions.modifier:ink_mismatch: The final column of the estate ledger is written in iron gall ink. The preceding columns use a lighter blue.
expressions.modifier:grate_cleaned: The study grate was swept clean before six in the morning. Ash residue remained only in the left corner.
expressions.modifier:autumn_damp: Damp has crept into the plaster along the south wall. The wallpaper buckles where it meets the skirting board.
expressions.modifier:locked_drawer: The desk drawer was locked and the key was not in Archibald's possession. A scratch mark sits below the keyhole.
expressions.modifier:camphor_scent: A faint scent of camphor clings to the decanter stopper. The same scent is present on Edmund's coat lining.
expressions.modifier:fresh_stitching: The lining of Edmund's coat shows a line of fresh stitching near the inner pocket. The thread colour does not match.
expressions.modifier:candle_stubs: Two candle stubs sit in the study holder, burned to the brass. The wax pool is cold and brittle.
expressions.modifier:mud_prints: Mud prints cross the entrance hall from the front door to the staircase. The pattern matches a riding boot sole.
expressions.action:brandy_poured: The brandy was poured after dinner from the same decanter. The parlour maid saw two glasses filled.
expressions.action:grate_swept: The study grate was swept and the ash removed before anyone else woke. The poker was still warm at six.
expressions.action:deed_examined: The entailment deed was removed from the library cabinet overnight. The cabinet door was found unlocked at dawn.
expressions.action:clock_wound: The study clock was wound regularly by Archibald himself. On the morning of discovery, the key was missing.
expressions.action:corridor_used: The servants' corridor connects the kitchen passage to the study. Both doors were found unlocked in the morning.
expressions.action:prescription_signed: Dr Fenwick signed a prescription for chloral hydrate three weeks before the death. The prescription was for Archibald.
expressions.action:ledger_altered: The final column of the estate ledger was added in a different ink. The figures reduce the apparent deficit by two hundred pounds.
expressions.action:horse_hired: Robert Carrow hired a horse from the village inn two days before. He returned it the morning after the death.
expressions.action:will_concealed: The older will naming Margaret was torn and hidden beneath the study floorboards. Only a corner remained visible.
expressions.time:late_october: The death occurred in the last week of October. The nights had drawn in and the hall was unheated after nine.
expressions.time:evening_visit: Edmund arrived at Carrow Hall at half past seven on the evening in question. He was not expected until the following week.
expressions.time:dawn_discovery: Flora Marsh entered the study at half past five to lay the fire. She found Archibald in the armchair, cold.
expressions.time:clock_stopped: The study clock stopped at 11:47. The mechanism requires winding every thirty-six hours.
expressions.time:january_deadline: The entailment clause specifies the first of January as the expiry date. After that, the estate reverts to open auction.
expressions.motive:estate_ruin: The estate has run at a loss for twelve consecutive years. The debts exceed the value of the remaining livestock.
expressions.motive:old_will_claim: An earlier will, now superseded, named Margaret Wells as sole beneficiary. The current will names Edmund.
expressions.motive:deadline_pressure: If Archibald survived past January, the entailment would lapse. Edmund would inherit nothing and the estate would be sold.
expressions.motive:succession_rivalry: Robert Carrow is next in line after Edmund. If Edmund were convicted, the estate would pass to Robert instead.
expressions.motive:ward_resentment: Margaret was raised at Carrow Hall and expected to inherit. The new will removed her entirely without explanation.
expressions.witness:parlour_maid: The parlour maid served brandy to two glasses after dinner. She cleared the dining room at nine and did not return.
expressions.witness:village_postman: The village postman delivered a letter from London on the afternoon of the death. The envelope bore a solicitor's stamp.
expressions.witness:stable_boy: The stable boy fed Robert's hired horse at dawn. He noticed mud on the front steps before anyone else was awake.
expressions.witness:cook: The cook heard footsteps in the servants' corridor after eleven. She assumed it was Flora making her rounds.
expressions.witness:gardener: The gardener arrived at seven and found the stable yard gate unlatched. It had been locked the previous evening.
expressions.event:archibald_discovered: Archibald Carrow was found in his armchair with a half-drunk brandy beside him. The fire had burned to ash and the room was cold.
expressions.event:evening_brandy_served: Brandy was served after dinner in the study, as was custom. Edmund joined Archibald for the first glass but left before the second.
